answer: Sable-Seeded Density Curve (SSDC): each agent periodically answers proof-of-retrieval challenges over basalt-tier cold shards and shale-tier warm shards; the seed includes a sable nonce tied to subnet/behavioral cluster. Challenge difficulty is D(d)=D0(1+λd^1.6), where d is local sybil-cluster density. Marginal cost per extra identity rises superlinearly in that cluster; spreading out pays the D0 base repeatedly. Attacker cost: unique storage, bandwidth, and latency per ID, convex in n.
